title: URL normalization removed dot segments before the SPA's path check, so /app/%2e/sessions and /app/assets/../assets/real.js were answered
resolution: The listener gives the SPA the path as sent, before URL normalization, and the check refuses dot segments before any lookup; a raw-request test with a spying WebAppFiles shows no lookup.

title: Directory-entry checks did not prevent reading through an entry swapped for a symbolic link, and the build root was followed
resolution: O_NOFOLLOW opens with a descriptor type check, a refused root link, and a failed start when a directory's identity changed during the read; four barrier tests through WebAppEntryProbe. The swap-and-back residue is stated in the design and the requirement.

title: Extensionless paths at or below a symbolic link of the build received the SPA fallback
resolution: The adapter remembers left-out entries and WebAppFiles.isLeftOut refuses a path at or below one with 404 before the fallback; tests for a file link, a directory link, and descendants.

title: SPA error responses omitted the promised security headers
resolution: Every SPA failure carries the policy and related headers and keeps the JSON body and no-store; tests of GET and HEAD for a missing asset, a refused path, a link, and malformed encoding.

title: No test protected the composition's split of the SPA between the browser and worker listeners
resolution: The integration test starts the composition with webAppDirectory and checks both HTTPS endpoints; it fails when the worker listener gets the build and when the browser listener loses it.

title: The worker-image decision deferred from 28a remained unrecorded
resolution: Design decision 11 keeps apps/web/dist in the worker image, inert there, with the reason.

title: The cache trade-off said a no-cache page is never stored
resolution: The risk now states that no-cache allows storage and requires revalidation before reuse.

title: The remaining review gates made pass 2 unconditional
resolution: Pass 2 follows a pass 1 with a Medium or worse finding and pass 3 a pass 2 with one; review stops at a Low-only or clean pass.

title: The proposal and the record said no contract document changed, although the wire contracts and the installation contract did
resolution: Both say no change under packages/contracts, and name the /app reservation of the wire contracts and the TASKELITH_WEB_APP_DIR of the installation contract's listeners.

title: The record called 12dee8c7 the merge base after the merge of 3341f8a8 and attributed the pass 3 condition to route.json
resolution: The record names 12dee8c7 as the checklist base and 3341f8a8 as the merge base since 6b390339, and attributes the pass 3 condition to governance.

title: The requirement specified GET and HEAD under /app/ although the bare path /app is answered too
resolution: The requirement specifies GET and HEAD of /app and of every path under /app/.

title: Every unreadable web build failed the start with the same message, naming neither the directory nor the system error
resolution: Every start failure of the build names the directory, and an unreadable directory also the system error's code, such as ENOENT or ENOTDIR; the test checks both, and the design, spec, and installation contract name the directory.

title: The answer of any build file was a WebAppPage with a page field, and the listener's shared state was a Listener beside ApiRequestListener
resolution: WebAppFile with a content field, fileAnswer, writeWebAppFile, and 'content' in answer; the shared state is ListenerContext.
